verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official TypeScript Agent SDK (`@letta-ai/letta-agent-sdk`, running in Node.js and browser/React Native) with memory APIs: starting memory files plus `persona` and `human` memory conveniences. Nothing in the pack shows an official Python SDK, so the multi-language, equivalent-memory-API part of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: an official Python SDK, evidence of memory-API parity between Python and TypeScript, and independent corroboration.
